verdict.rationale: Token2 sells hardware security keys, so a direct-to-employee delivery service driven by an API or console is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence covers only key management tools and bulk Entra ID registration through the Graph API. That is credential provisioning, not physical shipment of keys to distributed employees, so it earns no credit here, and no shipping or delivery-ordering API or console is documented.

support.subject: As an IT admin, an enterprise delivery service ships keys directly to distributed employees, driven by an API or console rather than manual logistics
